CREATE TABLE Invoice.MedSupp_BatchSummary_TEMP( 
 MedSupp_BatchSummary_TEMPID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED, 
 BLIV_CREATE_DTM DATETIME NOT NULL, 
 SUM_NET_DUE MONEY NOT NULL, 
 BatchCount INT NOT NULL
)

 ON Invoice.MedSupp_BatchSummary_TEMP(BLIV_CREATE_DTM)

 )

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT       x.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,       SUM(x.BLEI_NET_DUE) AS SUM_NET_DUE,       COUNT(x.BLIV_ID) AS BatchCnt   FROM (     SELECT           INV.BLIV_ID,         TRUNC(INV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) AS BLIV_CREATE_DTM,        INV.BLEI_NET_DUE     FROM FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INV     WHERE (INV.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'     AND TRUNC(INV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) < TRUNC(SYSDATE)     AND TRUNC(INV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) > ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -12)      )              UNION      SELECT          i.BLIV_ID,         TRUNC(i.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) AS BLIV_CREATE_DTM,          i.BLEI_NET_DUE FROM     FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP g               INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC s         ON g.GRGR_CK = s.GRGR_CK AND g.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER m          ON s.SBSB_CK = m.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG e          ON m.MEME_CK = e.MEME_CK      INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP bg         ON m.MEME_RECORD_NO = bg.BGBG_ID      INNER JOIN FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE i          ON bg.BGBG_ID = i.BGBG_ID         AND TRUNC(i.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) < TRUNC(SYSDATE)         AND TRUNC(i.BLIV_CREATE_DTM) > ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -12)                 ) x GROUP BY x.BLIV_CREATE_DTM ORDER BY x.BLIV_CREATE_DTM

DECLARE
	@ReadyBatchStatusId INT, 
	@EventTypeId INT, 
	@InfoEventSeverityId INT,
	@CriticalEventSeverityId INT, 
	@ModuleId INT,
	@BatchCategoryID INT,  
	@BatchIdList VARCHAR(MAX), 
	@BatchIdCount INT, 
	@EventDesc VARCHAR(MAX), 
	@ErrorOperation CHAR(5) = 'MERGE', 
	@ErrorObject CHAR(13) = 'Invoice.Batch', 
	@ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX) 

SET @ReadyBatchStatusId = @ReadyBatchStatusID
SET @EventTypeId = @EventTypeID
SET @InfoEventSeverityId = @InfoEventSeverityID 
SET @CriticalEventSeverityId = @CriticalEventSeverityID
SET @ModuleId = @ModuleID
SET @BatchCategoryID = @BatchCategoryID

CREATE TABLE #MergeOutput( 
	BatchId INT NULL,
	ActionTaken VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
) 

BEGIN TRANSACTION

	BEGIN TRY 
		MERGE INTO Invoice.Batch AS tgt
		USING ( 
			SELECT 
				BLIV_CREATE_DTM, 
				SUM_NET_DUE, 
				BatchCount 
			FROM Invoice.MedSupp_BatchSummary_TEMP
		) AS src ( 
			BLIVCreateDtm, 
			BLIVNetDue, 
			BatchCnt
		) 
		ON ( 
			tgt.BLIVCreateDtm = src.BLIVCreateDtm
				AND tgt.BatchCategoryID = @BatchCategoryID
		)
		WHEN MATCHED 
			AND tgt.BatchStatusID = @ReadyBatchStatusId THEN 
		UPDATE SET 
			tgt.BLIVNetDue = src.BLIVNetDue, 
			tgt.BatchCnt = src.BatchCnt, 
			tgt.run_datetime = GETDATE()
		WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN 
		INSERT ( 
			BLIVNetDue, 
			BatchStatusId, 
			BatchCnt, 
			BLIVCreateDtm, 
			run_datetime, 
			BatchCategoryID	
		) 
		VALUES (

				@EventTypeId,
